name: comp-382
blurb: Notification bell button with popover list of recent activities and unread badge.
description: Bell icon button with unread badge, opens Popover showing notification list with user actions, timestamps, Mark all as read button, and unread indicator dots.
use_when: You need an interactive notification center showing activity feed with read/unread state.
avoid_when: For static notification displays; use a card component instead.
a11y: Bell button has aria-label, unread dot has sr-only label. Notification items are keyboard-clickable buttons.
